source.document: GM Driver Assistance Systems Job Aid (Document ID #5577683, June 4, 2021)
source.additional_reference: GM Position Statement: Pre- and Post-Repair Scan of Collision Vehicles (prepostscancollisionvehicles.pdf)

general_requirements: Refer to the appropriate Service Information document for any additional programming operations needed if the component was replaced.

components.location: Windshield, near the inside rearview mirror (clipped into adhesive-mounted bracket)
triggers: Frontview Camera - Windshield is replaced
Frontview Camera - Windshield is removed from the bracket and reinstalled
Windshield is replaced or removed and reinstalled
After collision repair where damage exceeds minor outer body panel cosmetic distortion
Collision damage requires a suspension alignment to be performed
After any airbag deployment
DTC B1008 (Calibration Data) is set in the Frontview Camera - Windshield
DTC B395D (Camera Misaligned) is set in the Frontview Camera - Windshield
DTC B101E (Electronic Control Unit Software) is set in the Active Safety Control Module

components.location: Center grill area behind the brand emblem, or behind the lower fascia (varies by model)
components.calibration_note: Because of the location at the front of the vehicle, this module is susceptible to damage in even minor collisions.
triggers: Long Range Radar Sensor Module is replaced
Long Range Radar Sensor Module is removed and reinstalled
After collision repair where damage exceeds minor outer body panel cosmetic distortion
Collision damage requires a suspension alignment to be performed
After any airbag deployment
DTC B390C (Long Range Radar Sensor Module) is set in the Active Safety Control Module

components.component: Short Range Radar Sensor Module (Front Corner)
components.location: Behind front fascia, left and right (Cadillac with UGN, or Super Cruise equipped vehicles)
components.calibration_note: Because of the location behind the front fascia, these modules are susceptible to damage in even minor collisions.
triggers: Short Range Radar Sensor Module is replaced
Damage to the front fascia/bumper in the area of the module

components.component: Side Object Sensor Module / Rear Short Range Radar (Blind Spot)
components.location: Left and right vehicle body sides, behind the rear fascia or in the rear bumper. On Super Cruise equipped vehicles, the rear-mounted Short Range Radar Sensor Modules perform the blind spot function.
components.calibration_note: Modules are always performing coarse and fine learning during operation. Because of their location behind the rear fascia, modules are susceptible to damage in even minor collisions. Operating conditions that may slow learn: limited traffic/roadside objects, mud or snow buildup in sensor area, stickers/labels on rear fascia near sensor, damage to rear fascia or sensor bracket, incorrect collision repair.
triggers: Side Object Sensor Module is replaced
Rear-mounted Short Range Radar Sensor Module is replaced (Super Cruise)
Damage to rear fascia/bumper in the area of the module
DTC B218L (Side Object Sensor Module - Left) or B218R (Side Object Sensor Module - Right) is set

components.location: Front and rear fascias or bumpers
components.calibration_note: Learn is required on 2013+ Chevrolet Spark, 2017+ Chevrolet Cruze, 2018+ Chevrolet Equinox, 2018+ GMC Terrain, and Buick Envision; most other vehicles do not require a learn.
triggers: Park assist sensor is replaced (required on 2013+ Chevrolet Spark, 2017+ Chevrolet Cruze, 2018+ Chevrolet Equinox, 2018+ GMC Terrain, Buick Envision)
Damage to front or rear fascia in the area of the sensor

components.location: Front grill/fascia, left outside rearview mirror, right outside rearview mirror, and rear center of vehicle
components.calibration_note: Digital Surround Vision Cameras do NOT require learn. Only Analog Surround Vision Cameras require calibration.
triggers: Surround Vision Camera is replaced
Surround Vision Camera is removed and reinstalled
Fascia, grill, bumper, applique, outside rearview mirror, or Surround Vision Camera mounting location is removed or replaced

components.location: Front of vehicle, in fascia or grill
components.calibration_note: Digital Curb View Cameras do NOT require learn. Only Analog Curb View Cameras require calibration.
triggers: Curb View Camera is replaced
Curb View Camera is removed and reinstalled
Fascia, grill, or Curb View Camera mounting location is removed or replaced

components.location: Lower grille or fascia, below driver-side headlamp
triggers: Night Vision Camera is replaced
Night Vision Camera is removed and reinstalled
Fascia, grill, or Night Vision mounting location is removed or replaced
Vehicle ride height has significantly changed from the factory position
